source_interpretation: SrcAddr values are source-based logical client identifiers, not verified physical UAV identities.

excluded_model_fields.FlowID: Unique sequential flow/row identifier and possible file-order shortcut.
excluded_model_fields.SrcAddr: Logical client/grouping identity; retained only in traceability metadata.
excluded_model_fields.SrcPort: Only two values, strongly scenario-associated, and identical to DstPort in every audited row.
excluded_model_fields.DstPort: Only two values, strongly scenario-associated, and identical to SrcPort in every audited row.
excluded_model_fields.Protocol: Constant UDP in the released dataset.
excluded_model_fields.MeanPacketSize: Deterministically exposes the port/application regime in the audit and is redundant with packet/byte counts.
excluded_model_fields.label: Original multiclass target; preserved as original_label, never used as a model input.

suspicious_row_policy.rule: PacketDropRate outside [0,1] OR LostPackets greater than TxPackets
suspicious_row_policy.reason: The published meanings make these records internally suspicious; clipping or imputing would invent data.

duplicate_policy.reason: One global representative prevents repeated signatures within or across source-disjoint partitions.

heldout_assignment.algorithm: Deterministic largest-source-first greedy assignment minimizing normalized multiclass and total-row imbalance.
heldout_assignment.claim: Source-address-disjoint evaluation only; not scenario-, run-, temporal-, or verified-physical-UAV-disjoint evaluation.

future_training_imbalance_policy: Do not resample validation or test. In Phase 3, if needed, compute loss weights or a training sampler from training-client labels only.
